summary: ```markdown # Introduction to New Features of Marvelous Designer 11 ## Accessing the Store In the Marvelous Designer software, enter a shop that can buy clothing items. On the far left of the screen, there are the General, Basic, and Store shop labels. Select **Store** to open the shop. If you need to log in, please enter your user account and password on the Marvelous Designer official website in the pop-up window. Enter your business account and your personal account. ## Browsing Products Select the mouse to check the name and price of the object. For your favorite products, you can click the **Like** icon. You can enter keywords or use the filter to check the required categories. You can use the pull-down menu on the top right to sort the products. If you don't want to browse the products you have purchased, please open the display to view the products. ## Product Details If you want to double-click on a product, you can find detailed information under the **Details** tab on the right side. You can see the seller's name at the bottom of the product name. You can choose the purchase type of license, which is also displayed at the bottom of the product name. ## Viewing Products in 3D Click the **3D Viewer** button to view the product in a 3D environment. You can adjust the rendering style of the product according to your needs. Additionally, you can click on the basic information and product description in the details tab. You can view the product pictures uploaded by the seller. Click the arrow button on both sides of the picture or select the page number at the bottom to view other pictures. ## Additional Features Let's take a look at the grapes and figs in this clip. Click the icon on the right of the video to watch the review. There are several activities for buying. Click the **Amazon Problems** tab on the upper left to view the changes. Click and close to see the conveyor belt option you just made in three units in this clip. ## Completing Your Purchase Once you have selected your products, click again on **Next** to read through and prepare for the next step. Enter your purchase information and complete your purchase. Purchased products can be downloaded to "My Page" under the product page. Once the purchase is completed, return to the General and Basic page, and enter the purchased product, which can be used in Marvelous Designer. ```
